nodes.label: ADR-0013: WhatsApp pack bridge architecture
nodes.rationale: No official API exists for a PERSONAL WhatsApp account, so the only real option is the unofficial WhatsApp-Web protocol (Baileys) — nonzero account-ban risk. A separate bridge process owns the session (creds never touch the OS); pairing is the user's own explicit QR scan, never automated; sending is irreversible-class, auto_approve=false, always.
